content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] users, I have attached a diagram where I created custom text messages. On the designated screen, I want to edit the counter threshold and timer value, but haven't been successful. I am currently working with [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] operator device. Any advice is appreciated.

It appears that you haven't referenced any variable in the properties section for the timer. Which variable are you aiming for this component to respond to? Additionally, there's an inverted connector that seems to prevent it from activating.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble adjusting counter and timer values directly on the operator device screen, pointing to challenges with parameter changes during runtime. Further issues are noted with missing variable references and wiring errors, highlighting limitations in the configuration interface and workflow clarity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to modify timer and counter values on the operator device screen during normal operation, without extensive configuration.
